name: empreiteiro-skills
description: Claude Code skills by Empreiteiro: HTML presentations, posts for meme pages, multi-tenant SaaS backends, web UI patterns, data analytics with LLMs, shareable data cards, writing without AI tells, a build-test-ship workflow, A/B tests and animated reels.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: Create HTML presentations from a template and check them: structure, visuals, facts and a full review.

plugins.name: memes
plugins.description: Write and render posts for a humor/meme page in its own voice: text posts, chart memes, code-generated Reels and a 1-bit platform-game series.

plugins.name: saas-backend
plugins.description: Multi-tenant SaaS backends: secure API routes, schema changes and SQL portable across SQLite and Postgres, and data-source integrations.

plugins.name: web-ui
plugins.description: Web UI patterns: a shared search/filter bar, a shared sortable List view, screens in framework-less single-page apps, and layout review with screenshots at desktop and phone widths.

plugins.name: data-analytics
plugins.description: Answer questions over data and build data features with LLMs: profiling, text-to-SQL, file Q&A, joins, grounded answers, charts, connectors, reports, pipelines, identity resolution, AutoML and security.

plugins.name: data-cards
plugins.description: Design and check shareable data cards rendered to PNG on the server (Satori, next/og, @vercel/og): sheet, type, color roles, chart marks, copy, social formats and before/after render comparison.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Write without sounding like AI: a brand voice system, two editing passes, and the craft of fourteen forms from fiction to technical docs.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Take a change from request to production: isolate and plan it, run the gate, open and merge the PR, deploy and prove it by fetching the live site.

plugins.name: ab-testing
plugins.description: Run product A/B tests end to end: design the arms, assign accounts once at signup, build the results board, then promote the winner and remove the rest.

plugins.name: animated-reels
plugins.description: Turn a topic and a cast of drawn characters into a vertical 1080x1920 reel: script, voice, animation rendered frame by frame in Chromium, soundtrack, cover and caption.
